known.title: A leading delegation paragraph leaves a blank line that the Goal comparison takes as a change
known.summary: goalWork (plan.mjs:741-750) removes each live delegation line, and removes the blank line before it only when a kept line is already there (line 747). When a yolo adoption puts the delegation paragraph before an unchanged Goal (`<delegation line>`, a blank line, then `Fix the parser.`), the first line goes and the blank line after it stays, so the comparison gets `\nFix the parser.` against `Fix the parser.`, and editPlan advises a new plan-review round for an edit that only adds metadata. Plan decision 6 says that an edit that only sets the Mode or the delegation line needs no round. A fix must not trim leading code indentation, which goalWork keeps on purpose (lines 738-740).

known.title: The whole-owner exclusion branch of the query check has no test
known.summary: In targetsBenchmark, coversRepository accepts an exclusion of the whole owner on GitHub through `parts.length === 1` (score.mjs:1713), but the readScope query test (review-benchmark.test.mjs:5065-5085) covers only exclusions of the whole repository, of part of the repository, and of another site. A deletion of the owner-only branch fails no test, although it makes the allowed query `DocksDocks docs -site:github.com/DocksDocks` outside. Plan decision 6 says that a parser or matcher repair lists its input forms and tests each one.
